method: Parsed UAssetGUI JSON. Resolved positive package indices to Exports[n-1] and negative indices to Imports[-n-1]. Reconstructed UE4 Kismet VM instruction offsets with 8-byte object/property pointers, 12-byte FNames and expression sizes; total matched declared ScriptBytecodeSize for all listed and retained functions. JSON pointer array indices are zero-based; VM offsets are not file offsets. Statement rendering is an inspection aid, not executable or original source.

findings.finding: PlayerBP routes player input and component references; HeroComponent implements movement, flying, sprinting, attack dispatch and camera/FX coordination.

FistCannon is a Pressed action binding, routed to PlayerBP ubergraph offset 13855, then 13520. When GameInputState != 9, it reaches 12098 (SprintBtnReleased) and 12134 (LongRangeAttack); GameInputState==9 first checks tutorial interfaces and current tutorial number.

LongRangeAttack enters HeroComponent at 147918; jumps through ResetPressFlyUpKeyTime and ForceResetWaitMotion to state dispatch at 19595. Hit reaction blocks this path. CanMove state branches on MovementMode; flying calls HeroAirLongAttackFunc, ground input can call HeroComboLongAttackFunc or, when SuperPunchCounter>=1, HeroSuperLongAttackPunchFunc; ground with no movement calls HeroNormalLongAttackFunc. Chain states choose further air/combo/boss paths.

HeroNormalLongAttackFunc explicitly sets HeroPlayerState=6; enum display map resolves 6 to FistCannon. It resets sprint and selects left/right attack montages using LongAttackIndex, advancing/resetting the index between 0 and 1.

Normal long attack hit-object spawning is animation driven: AnimNotify_NormalLongAttack routes to HeroComponent.SpawnNormalLongAttack, which spawns BP_NormalLongAttackCollirion_C at AttackLocation and sets ChainLongAttack state (11) unless state is AirLongRangeAttacking (15).
findings.status: observed notification and spawn call chains

findings.finding: JumpAndFlyEvent first rejects hit reaction and dispatches player state/movement mode. Ground path calls Character.Jump; airborne fly path checks IsFlying?, enables controller yaw, disables orientation-to-movement, calls SetMovementMode(5,0), and spawns fly-start effect.
findings.status: observed conditional statements; mode5 is standard UE Flying interpretation

findings.finding: Movement parameters are assigned dynamically by SetMovementParam according to WalkMode, IsSprint, FlashMode, HeroPlayerState and movement mode; serialized defaults alone are not measured gameplay speeds.

Animation blueprint uses movement/state variables and dispatches hitbox creation, movement start/stop, chain windows and projectile spawning from AnimNotify events. Replacing animations must preserve equivalent event timings, not just visual poses.

serialized_defaults.scope: Serialized CDO/component overrides only, not full inherited defaults, runtime or measured values. Units retained as raw UE units.

rank_parameter_tables.scope: Literal values observed in static selection assignments. No runtime activation, attained speed or frame-rate behavior measured.

model_references.migration_implication: Replace skeleton/mesh/animation binding together; preserve or remap effect anchor/socket and animation-notify contracts. Homelander model itself has not been inspected.

limitations: Static decoded cooked assets only; game not run, timings/damage/range not measured.
Physical mouse/keyboard mapping is not established by PlayerBP action delegate binding; requires DefaultInput.ini or controller mapping evidence.
HeroComponent.FistCannon/LongRangeAttack is not automatically equivalent to laser vision; the decoded calls establish separate attack dispatch.
Recovered VM offsets are validated by total size but not a substitute for original editor node graph; branching and deferred/latent flow remain explicit.
No claim of exhaustive reconstruction of all 195 HeroComponent functions or all animation transitions.
No claim that the model can be swapped without retargeting; source skeleton and Homelander model compatibility remain unchecked.
